name: Master of Plague Magic
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Poxes**. When they are recruited, pick 2 spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Skilled Killer
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

name: One-cut, One-kill
text: While this fighter has made a Charge Move in the same activation, its melee attack rolls score a critical hit on a natural roll of a 5 or 6.

name: Ambitious Warlord
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 2 skills for them.

name: Tinkerer's Know-how
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

name: Mad Engineering
text: This fighter begins the battle with **d3 engineering points**. Once per activation, if this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can spend one of their engineering points to make the following bonus action: Engineer.

name: Engineer
text:
Pick a friendly fighter within 1" of this fighter, that is not engaged in melee, to be the target and then pick one of the following options:

- *Patch-up:* If the target is a *Contraption*, it heals d3 life.
- *Soup-up:* Pick 1 of the target’s ranged weapons to be *souped-up* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *souped-up*, increase it’s Rend value by 1. However if it misfires, treat the result as ‘backfire’ (do not roll on the table).

name: Spellcaster
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of the Under-Tunnels**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Holy Magic
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Poxes**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Seasoned Warrior
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

name: Unpredictable Movement
text: This fighter has a Move value of 2d6". Each time it makes a move, roll the dice to determine its Move value for that move, (for example, if this fighter makes a Run Move, first roll 2d6" to determine its Move value, then roll an additional d6 and add it to the Move value as normal).

name: Splat!
text: After this fighter finishes a Charge move, pick 1 enemy fighter they are engaged with. That fighter is hit with the following attack 3 times: Rend -1, Damage 1.

name: Large and Heavy
text: This fighter cannot climb or jump. In addition, each time this fighter is set-up, they must be set up on the battlefield floor and they must finish each move on the battlefield floor.
